'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link'; // L'IMPORT MANQUANT EST ICI
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export default function Verify() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('file');
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [titleQuery, setTitleQuery] = useState('');
  
  const [timelineData, setTimelineData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [timelineLoading, setTimelineLoading] = useState(true);
  const [timelineMode, setTimelineMode] = useState<'live' | 'period'>('live');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== 'timeline') return;
    const fetchTimeline = () => {
      setTimelineLoading(true);
      const url = timelineMode === 'live' 
        ? '/api/verify/timeline?live=true'
        : `/api/verify/timeline?start=${startDate}&end=${endDate}`;
        
      fetch(url).then(res => res.json()).then(data => {
        setTimelineData(data.timeline || []);
        setTimelineLoading(false);
      });
    };
    fetchTimeline();
    if (timelineMode === 'live') {
      const interval = setInterval(fetchTimeline, 5000);
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [tab, timelineMode, startDate, endDate]);

  async function verifyFile(file: File) {
    setLoading(true);
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const hash = sha256(new Uint8Array(buffer));
    let hashStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < hash.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hash[i]);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: btoa(hashStr) }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function verifyHash(input: string) {
    if(!input) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: input }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function searchByTitle() {
    if(!titleQuery) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: titleQuery }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  const timeAgo = (dateStr: string) => {
    const diff = Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
    if (diff < 1) return "Ã€ l'instant";
    if (diff === 1) return "Il y a 1 minute";
    if (diff < 60) return `Il y a ${diff} minutes`;
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR');
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 pb-32 md:pb-6 max-w-2xl md:max-w-5xl mx-auto font-sans w-full">
      <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
        <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-color)]">
          <Link href="/seal" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition">âœï¸ Sceller</Link>
          <Link href="/verify" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow text-[#E76F51]">ğŸ” VÃ©rifier</Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2 text-center" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>VÃ©rifier & DÃ©couvrir.</h1>
      <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)] italic mb-6 text-center">Prouvez l'authenticitÃ© ou dÃ©couvrez le monde.</p>
      
      <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] p-1 rounded-xl mb-6">
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('file');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='file'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Fichier</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('hash');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='hash'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Hash</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('title');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='title'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Titre</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('timeline');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='timeline'?'bg-[#E76F51] text-white shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: tab==='timeline' ? '#FFF' : 'var(--text-main)'}}>Chronologie</button>
      </div>

      {tab === 'file' && (
        <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-[#4A90C2] bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-8 rounded-xl text-center">
          <input type="file" onChange={e=>e.target.files?.[0] && verifyFile(e.target.files[0])} className="w-full text-sm" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'hash' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <input type="text" placeholder="Collez le hash (ex: b2e7...)" className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl outline-none font-mono bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} onChange={e=>verifyHash(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'title' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <input type="text" placeholder="Titre de l'Å“uvre (ex: Mon premier roman)" className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl outline-none bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={titleQuery} onChange={e=>setTitleQuery(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && searchByTitle()} />
          <button onClick={searchByTitle} className="w-full bg-[#4A90C2] text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold">Rechercher</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'timeline' && (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          
          {/* Filtres de la frise */}
          <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-lg">
              <button onClick={() => setTimelineMode('live')} className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition ${timelineMode === 'live' ? 'bg-white shadow text-[#E76F51]' : 'opacity-50'}`}>En direct</button>
              <button onClick={() => setTimelineMode('period')} className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition ${timelineMode === 'period' ? 'bg-white shadow text-[#E76F51]' : 'opacity-50'}`}>Par pÃ©riode</button>
            </div>
            
            {timelineMode === 'period' && (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input type="date" value={startDate} onChange={e => setStartDate(e.target.value)} className="flex-1 border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-2 text-xs bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} />
                <input type="date" value={endDate} onChange={e => setEndDate(e.target.value)} className="flex-1 border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-2 text-xs bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {timelineLoading ? (
            <p className="text-center font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)] py-10">Synchronisation...</p>
          ) : timelineData.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-center italic text-[var(--text-muted)] py-10">Aucun sceau sur cette pÃ©riode.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="relative pl-6">
              {/* La ligne verticale */}
              <div className="absolute left-2.5 top-2 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-[#E76F51] opacity-30"></div>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {timelineData.map((item, index) => (
                  <div key={item.id} className="relative animate-fade-in">
                    {/* Le point */}
                    <div className="absolute -left-[1.35rem] top-1.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#E76F51] border-2 border-[var(--bg-main)] shadow-sm"></div>
                    
                    <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:border-[#E76F51] transition">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-1">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>@{item.author}</span>
                        <span className="text-[0.6rem] font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">{timeAgo(item.timestamp)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-sm" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{item.title}</div>

      {tab !== 'pulse' && result && (

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function Cockpit() {
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any>(null);
  const [activities, setActivities] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [pendingPacts, setPendingPacts] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    setHandle(h);

    if (!pubkey) { setLoading(false); return; }

    // Profil
    fetch(`/api/profil?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { if (d.handle) setProfile(d); })
      .catch(() => {});

    // ActivitÃ© (rafraÃ®chie toutes les 30s)
    const fetchActivity = () => {
      fetch(`/api/profil/activity?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setActivities(d.activities || []))
        .catch(() => {});
    };
    fetchActivity();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchActivity, 30000);

    // Pactes en attente
    fetch(`/api/pacts/pending?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => setPendingPacts(d.count || 0))
      .catch(() => {});

    setLoading(false);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // Stockage dynamique
  const maxQuotaGB = 0.1; // 100 Mo Free
  const usedBytes = profile?.used_bytes || 0;
  const usedGB = (usedBytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2);
  const percentage = Math.min(100, (parseFloat(usedGB) / maxQuotaGB) * 100);

  // Ã‰quipe dynamique (toi + amis)
  const teamCount = 1 + (profile?.friends_count || 0);
  const teamMax = 1; // Free = 1 siÃ¨ge, PRO = 5

  function timeAgo(dateStr: string) {
    const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
    if (diff < 1) return "Ã  l'instant";
    if (diff < 60) return `il y a ${diff} min`;
    if (diff < 1440) return `il y a ${Math.floor(diff/60)}h`;
    return `il y a ${Math.floor(diff/1440)}j`;
  }

  return (
    <aside className="hidden lg:flex flex-col w-[340px] bg-[var(--bg-main)] border-l border-[var(--border-color)] h-full overflow-y-auto shrink-0">
      
      {/* BLOC 1 : STATUT & QUOTAS RÃ‰ELS */}
      <div className="p-6 border-b border-[var(--border-color)]">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-4">Mon Espace Pro</h3>
        
        <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-4 shadow-sm mb-4">

FICHIER : ./src/db/pool.ts

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { requireDb } from '@/lib/env';

let _pool: Pool | null = null;

function create(): Pool {
  const url = requireDb();
  const pool = new Pool({
    connectionString: url,
    max: 5,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30_000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: true },
  });
  pool.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error('[pg] idle client error:', err.message);
  });
  return pool;
}

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!_pool) _pool = create();
  return _pool;
}

// Compat : `import { pool } from '@/db/pool'` continue de fonctionner.
export const pool = new Proxy({} as Pool, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getPool() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

function isDbError(e: any): boolean {
  const code = e?.code;
  if (['ECONNREFUSED', 'ENOTFOUND', 'ETIMEDOUT', '28P01', '3D000', '57P01'].includes(code)) return true;
  return /ECONNREFUSED|ENOTFOUND|timeout|connect.*pool|database/i.test(String(e?.message || ''));
}

export function apiError(e: unknown, fallback = 'Erreur serveur'): NextResponse {
  if (isDbError(e)) {
    console.error('[api-error] base injoignable :', (e as any)?.message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Base de donnÃ©es injoignable. RÃ©essayez dans un instant.' },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
  console.error('[api-error]', e);
  return NextResponse.json({ error: fallback }, { status: 500 });
}

// Validation centralisÃ©e des variables d'environnement.
// Ã‰choue TÃ”T avec un message clair au lieu de produire `undefined/undefined/clÃ©`.

function clean(v: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!v) return undefined;
  return v.trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
}

function required(name: string): string {
  const v = clean(process.env[name]);
  if (!v) throw new Error(`Variable d'environnement manquante ou vide : ${name}`);
  return v;
}

function optional(name: string, def = ''): string {
  return clean(process.env[name]) ?? def;
}

export function requireS3(): { endpoint: string; bucket: string; region: string } {
  const endpoint = required('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = required('S3_BUCKET').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const region = optional('AWS_REGION', 'us-west-004');
  return { endpoint, bucket, region };
}

export function requireDb(): string {
  return required('DATABASE_URL');
}

// Nettoyage HTML robuste : vire les menus, footers, nav, et dÃ©duplique les lignes.

export function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  // 1. Supprimer les blocs de bruit rÃ©cursivement
  let cleaned = html
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<noscript\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/noscript>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<iframe\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/iframe>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<svg\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/svg>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<nav\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/nav>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<header\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/header>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<footer\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/footer>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<aside\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/aside>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<form\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/form>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<button\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/button>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<select\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/select>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '');

  // 2. Essayer d'extraire le main ou article en prioritÃ©
  const mainMatch =
    cleaned.match(/<main\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/main>/i) ||
    cleaned.match(/<article\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/article>/i);

  if (mainMatch && mainMatch[1].length > 300) {
    cleaned = mainMatch[1];
  }

  // 3. Convertir les balises en sauts de ligne + dÃ©coder les entitÃ©s
  let text = cleaned
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gim, '\n')
    .replace(/<\/(p|div|h[1-6]|li|tr|section)>/gim, '\n')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&#x27;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&apos;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&hellip;/g, 'â€¦')
    .replace(/&laquo;/g, 'Â«')
    .replace(/&raquo;/g, 'Â»');

  // 4. DÃ©couper en lignes propres
  const lines = text
    .split('\n')
    .map((l) => l.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
    .filter((l) => l.length > 0);

  // 5. DÃ©dupliquer les lignes consÃ©cutives identiques
  const deduped: string[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (deduped.length === 0 || deduped[deduped.length - 1] !== line) {
      deduped.push(line);
    }
  }

  // 6. Retirer les lignes trop courtes (bruit : "Menu", "FR", "EN", "OK")
  const filtered = deduped.filter((l) => l.length > 4);

  // 7. DÃ©dupliquer les lignes qui reviennent plus de 3 fois (vrai bruit de nav)
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const l of filtered) counts.set(l, (counts.get(l) || 0) + 1);
  const final = filtered.filter((l) => (counts.get(l) || 0) <= 3);

  return final.join('\n');
}

// DÃ©tecte si le contenu est rÃ©ellement diffÃ©rent (ignore les changements de date/pub)
export function isSignificantChange(oldText: string, newText: string): boolean {
  const oldLines = new Set(oldText.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean));
  const newLines = new Set(newText.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean));
  let added = 0;
  let removed = 0;
  for (const l of newLines) if (!oldLines.has(l)) added++;
  for (const l of oldLines) if (!newLines.has(l)) removed++;

  // Ignore les micro-changements (moins de 3 lignes modifiÃ©es)
  return added + removed >= 3;
}

FICHIER : ./src/lib/merkle.ts

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

/**
 * Prend une liste de hashs (en Base64) et calcule le Hash Racine (Merkle Root).
 * Utilise Uint8Array pour Ã©viter les conflits de types avec Buffer.
 */
export function buildMerkleRoot(hashesB64: string[]): string {
  if (hashesB64.length === 0) return '';
  if (hashesB64.length === 1) return hashesB64[0];

  // Convertir les hashs Base64 en Uint8Array
  let currentLevel: Uint8Array[] = hashesB64.map(h => {
    const binaryString = atob(h);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  });

  while (currentLevel.length > 1) {
    const nextLevel: Uint8Array[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < currentLevel.length; i += 2) {
      if (i + 1 < currentLevel.length) {
        // ConcatÃ©ner les deux hashs
        const combined = new Uint8Array(currentLevel[i].length + currentLevel[i + 1].length);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i], 0);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i + 1], currentLevel[i].length);
        
        // Calculer le hash du rÃ©sultat
        const hash = sha256(combined);
        nextLevel.push(hash);
      } else {
        // S'il reste un Ã©lÃ©ment impair, on le passe au niveau supÃ©rieur
        nextLevel.push(currentLevel[i]);
      }
    }
    currentLevel = nextLevel;
  }

  // Convertir le Uint8Array final en Base64
  const root = currentLevel[0];
  let binary = '';
  const len = root.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(root[i]);
  }
  
  return btoa(binary);
}

2. En franÃ§ais
3. Si plusieurs changements, rÃ©sume LE PLUS IMPORTANT (prix, date, mention lÃ©gale)
4. Ne dis jamais "le site a changÃ©". Dis directement CE QUI a changÃ©.
5. Format naturel et direct

Exemples de bonnes rÃ©ponses :
- "Le tarif de l'abonnement Pro est passÃ© de 49â‚¬ Ã  59â‚¬."
- "La mention 'Gratuit' a Ã©tÃ© supprimÃ©e de la page tarifs."
- "La date de mise Ã  jour est passÃ©e du 12 au 15 novembre."
- "Une nouvelle clause sur les donnÃ©es personnelles a Ã©tÃ© ajoutÃ©e."`;

export async function summarizeChange(
  oldText: string,
  newText: string,
  url: string
): Promise<string | null> {
  const apiKey = process.env.GROQ_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) {
    console.warn('[oracle-summary] GROQ_API_KEY manquante, rÃ©sumÃ© ignorÃ©.');
    return null;
  }

  // Limiter pour Ã©conomiser les tokens (les 3000 premiers caractÃ¨res suffisent)
  const MAX_CHARS = 3000;
  const oldSnippet = oldText.slice(0, MAX_CHARS);
  const newSnippet = newText.slice(0, MAX_CHARS);

  // Si le contenu est vide, pas la peine d'appeler Groq
  if (!oldSnippet.trim() || !newSnippet.trim()) return null;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: 'llama-3.1-70b-versatile',
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
          {
            role: 'user',
            content: `URL: ${url}\n\n=== VERSION PRÃ‰CÃ‰DENTE ===\n${oldSnippet}\n\n=== VERSION ACTUELLE ===\n${newSnippet}`,
          },
        ],
        max_tokens: 120,
        temperature: 0.1,
      }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000), // 8s max pour ne pas bloquer le Cron
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.text();
      console.error('[oracle-summary] Groq error:', res.status, err.slice(0, 200));
      return null;
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const summary = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim();
    return summary || null;
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[oracle-summary] Exception:', e?.message || e);
    return null;
  }
}

// En-tÃªte .ots complet (31 octets) :
// \x00 + "OpenTimestamps" (14) + \x00\x00 + "Proof" (5) + \x00 + 8 octets magiques
const HEADER_MAGIC = Buffer.from(
  '004f70656e54696d657374616d7073000050726f6f6600bf89e2e884e89294',
  'hex'
);

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

const CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
const MAX_PROOF_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

export type OtsResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  proof?: Buffer;
  calendars: string[];
  error?: string;
};

function toDetachedOts(hash: Uint8Array, calendarBody: Buffer): Buffer {
  if (calendarBody.length >= HEADER_MAGIC.length &&
      calendarBody.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
    return calendarBody;
  }
  // Si le calendar a renvoyÃ© une preuve partielle sans header, on l'encapsule proprement
  const hashBuffer = Buffer.from(hash);
  return Buffer.concat([
    HEADER_MAGIC,
    Buffer.from([0x01, 0x08]), // version 1 + op SHA-256
    hashBuffer,
    calendarBody,
  ]);
}

async function submitOne(url: string, hash: Uint8Array): Promise<Buffer> {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
      Accept: 'application/vnd.opentimestamps.v1',
      'User-Agent': 'sceau/1.0',
    },
    body: Buffer.from(hash),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
  if (buf[0] === 0x3c || buf[0] === 0x7b) throw new Error('rÃ©ponse non binaire (HTML/JSON)');
  return buf;
}

export async function submitToOts(hash: Uint8Array): Promise<OtsResult> {
  if (hash.length !== 32) return { ok: false, calendars: [], error: 'hash_invalid_length' };

  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(CALENDARS.map((u) => submitOne(u, hash)));

  const successes: string[] = [];
  let body: Buffer | undefined;
  settled.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
      successes.push(CALENDARS[i]);
      if (!body) body = r.value;
    }
  });

  if (!body) return { ok: false, calendars: successes, error: 'all_calendars_failed' };
  return { ok: true, proof: toDetachedOts(hash, body), calendars: successes };
}

// Upgrade : interroge les calendars avec le hash de l'ENGAGEMENT contenu dans la preuve
// (pas le hash du fichier â€” sinon Ã§a ne confirme jamais).
export async function upgradeOts(hash: Uint8Array, proofBase64: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  let engagement: Uint8Array = hash;
  try {
    const raw = Buffer.from(proofBase64, 'base64');
    if (raw.length > HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34 &&
        raw.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
      const version = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length];
      const op = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length + 1];
      if (version === 0x01 && op === 0x08) {
        engagement = raw.subarray(HEADER_MAGIC.length + 2, HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34);
      }
    }
  } catch { /* fallback hash */ }

  const hashHex = Buffer.from(engagement).toString('hex');
  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(
    CALENDARS.map(async (url) => {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/timestamp/${hashHex}`, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
      return buf;
    })
  );

  let best: Buffer | null = null;
  for (const r of settled) {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && (!best || r.value.length > best.length)) best = r.value;
  }
  return best;
}

import { S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

let _client: S3Client | null = null;

function create(): S3Client {
  const { endpoint, region } = requireS3();
  const accessKeyId = (process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || '').trim();
  const secretAccessKey = (process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey) {
    throw new Error('ClÃ©s S3 manquantes : AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }
  return new S3Client({
    region,
    endpoint,
    credentials: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey },
    forcePathStyle: true,
    requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
    responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
  });
}

export function getR2Client(): S3Client {
  if (!_client) _client = create();
  return _client;
}

export const r2Client = new Proxy({} as S3Client, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getR2Client() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

// Cache mÃ©moire des robots.txt (TTL 1h)
const cache = new Map<string, { rules: string[]; allowAll: boolean; expires: number }>();
const TTL = 3600_000;

export async function isAllowedByRobots(url: string, userAgent = 'SCEAU-Bot'): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    const root = `${u.protocol}//${u.hostname}`;
    const cached = cache.get(root);
    if (cached && cached.expires > Date.now()) {
      return evaluate(cached, u.pathname, userAgent);
    }

    const res = await fetch(`${root}/robots.txt`, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': userAgent },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      // Pas de robots.txt = tout autorisÃ©
      const entry = { rules: [], allowAll: true, expires: Date.now() + TTL };
      cache.set(root, entry);
      return true;
    }

    const text = await res.text();
    const lines = text.split('\n').map(l => l.trim());
    const rules: string[] = [];
    let inOurSection = false;
    let allowAll = false;

    for (const line of lines) {
      if (line.startsWith('#') || !line) continue;
      const [key, ...rest] = line.split(':');
      const k = key.trim().toLowerCase();
      const v = rest.join(':').trim();
      
      if (k === 'user-agent') {
        inOurSection = v === '*' || v.toLowerCase().includes('sceau');
        if (inOurSection && v === '*') allowAll = true;
      } else if (inOurSection && (k === 'disallow' || k === 'allow')) {
        rules.push(`${k}:${v}`);
      }
    }

    const entry = { rules, allowAll, expires: Date.now() + TTL };
    cache.set(root, entry);
    return evaluate(entry, u.pathname, userAgent);
  } catch {
    // Erreur rÃ©seau : on refuse par prudence
    return false;
  }
}

function evaluate(entry: { rules: string[]; allowAll: boolean }, path: string, _ua: string): boolean {
  // RÃ¨gles les plus longues d'abord (spÃ©cifiques)
  const sorted = [...entry.rules].sort((a, b) => {
    const al = a.split(':').slice(1).join(':').length;
    const bl = b.split(':').slice(1).join(':').length;
    return bl - al;
  });

  for (const rule of sorted) {
    const [type, pattern] = rule.split(':');
    if (!pattern) {
      if (type === 'disallow') return false;
      continue;
    }
    const regex = new RegExp('^' + pattern.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\*/g, '.*'));
    if (regex.test(path)) {
      return type === 'allow';
    }
  }

  return true; // Par dÃ©faut, autorisÃ©
}

FICHIER : ./src/lib/safe-fetcher.ts

// Module unique de tÃ©lÃ©chargement pour Archive, Cron et Oracle.
// RÃ¨gles : HTTPS only, pas d'IP internes, robots.txt, timeout, taille max, redirections validÃ©es.

import { isAllowedByRobots } from './robots';

const USER_AGENT = 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0 (+https://sceau-app.vercel.app)';
const TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;

function isPrivateIp(hostname: string): boolean {
  const h = hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1' || h === '::1' || h === '0.0.0.0') return true;
  if (/^10\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^192\.168\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^169\.254\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^fc00:/i.test(h) || /^fe80:/i.test(h)) return true;
  return false;
}

function isSafeProtocol(url: URL): boolean {
  return url.protocol === 'https:';
}

export type FetchResult =
  | { ok: true; html: string; finalUrl: string; statusCode: number }
  | { ok: false; error: string; statusCode?: number };

export async function safeFetch(inputUrl: string): Promise<FetchResult> {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(inputUrl);
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, error: 'URL invalide' };
  }

  if (!isSafeProtocol(url)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'HTTPS obligatoire' };
  }

  if (isPrivateIp(url.hostname)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Adresse interne interdite' };
  }

  if (url.username || url.password) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'URL avec identifiants interdite' };
  }

  // VÃ©rifie robots.txt
  const allowed = await isAllowedByRobots(url.toString(), USER_AGENT);
  if (!allowed) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'BloquÃ© par robots.txt' };
  }

  let currentUrl = url.toString();
  let redirects = 0;

  while (redirects <= MAX_REDIRECTS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(currentUrl, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': USER_AGENT, 'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml' },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
        redirect: 'manual',
      });

      // GÃ¨re les redirections manuellement
      if (res.status >= 300 && res.status < 400) {
        const location = res.headers.get('location');
        if (!location) return { ok: false, error: 'Redirection sans location', statusCode: res.status };
        
        const nextUrl = new URL(location, currentUrl);
        if (!isSafeProtocol(nextUrl) || isPrivateIp(nextUrl.hostname)) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Redirection vers destination interdite', statusCode: res.status };
        }
        currentUrl = nextUrl.toString();
        redirects++;
        continue;
      }

      if (!res.ok) {
        return { ok: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}`, statusCode: res.status };
      }

      // VÃ©rifie Content-Length
      const contentLength = res.headers.get('content-length');
      if (contentLength && parseInt(contentLength) > MAX_BYTES) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Contenu trop lourd', statusCode: res.status };
      }

      // Lit en streaming avec limite
      const reader = res.body?.getReader();
      if (!reader) return { ok: false, error: 'Pas de body', statusCode: res.status };

      let bytes = 0;
      const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        bytes += value.byteLength;
        if (bytes > MAX_BYTES) {
          reader.cancel();
          return { ok: false, error: 'Contenu trop lourd', statusCode: res.status };
        }
        chunks.push(value);
      }

      const html = new TextDecoder().decode(Buffer.concat(chunks));
      return { ok: true, html, finalUrl: currentUrl, statusCode: res.status };
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e?.name === 'TimeoutError' || e?.name === 'AbortError') {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Timeout' };
      }
      return { ok: false, error: e?.message || 'Erreur rÃ©seau' };
    }
  }

  return { ok: false, error: 'Trop de redirections' };
}

export function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n')
    .trim();
}

export function extractTitle(html: string, fallbackUrl: string): string {
  const t = html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  if (t?.[1]) {
    const clean = t[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 200) return clean;
  }
  const h1 = html.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/i);
  if (h1?.[1]) {
    const clean = h1[1].replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 100) return clean;
  }
  try {
    const u = new URL(fallbackUrl);
    return u.pathname === '/' ? u.hostname : `${u.hostname}${u.pathname}`;
  } catch {
    return fallbackUrl;
  }
}

export function safeKeyPart(input: string, maxLen = 80): string {
  if (!input) return 'file';
  const ascii = input.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const cleaned = ascii.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '-');
  const safe = cleaned.replace(/^\.+/, '').replace(/\.{2,}/g, '.').replace(/-+/g, '-');
  return (safe || 'file').slice(0, maxLen);
}

export function buildS3Key(opts: {
  authorId: string; hashBase64: string; originalName: string; prefix?: string;
}): string {
  const prefix = opts.prefix || 'seal';
  const authorShort = opts.authorId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  const hashShort = opts.hashBase64.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
  const safeName = safeKeyPart(opts.originalName, 80);
  return `${prefix}/${authorShort}/${hashShort}-${safeName}`;
}

export function extractS3Key(filePath: string): string | null {
  const endpoint = (process.env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = (process.env.S3_BUCKET || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const prefix = `${endpoint}/${bucket}/`;
  if (filePath.startsWith(prefix)) return filePath.slice(prefix.length);
  return filePath.split('/').pop() || null;
}

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

/**
 * Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 d'un fichier (Buffer ou Uint8Array).
 */
export function hashDocument(content: Uint8Array): string {
  const hash = sha256(content);
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * Ancre un hash sur la blockchain Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps.
 * Retourne la preuve .ots en base64, prÃªte Ã  Ãªtre stockÃ©e.
 */
export async function anchorToBitcoin(hashHex: string): Promise<{ otsProof: string | null, calendars: string[] }> {
  const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  const successes: string[] = [];
  let proof: Buffer | undefined;

  for (const url of CALENDARS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' },
        body: hashBytes,
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue;

      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      const magic = Buffer.from([0x00,0x4f,0x70,0x65,0x6e,0x54,0x69,0x6d,0x65,0x73,0x74,0x61,0x6d,0x70,0x73,0x00,0x00,0x50,0x72,0x6f,0x6f,0x66,0x00]);
      
      if (!buf.subarray(0, magic.length).equals(magic)) continue;

      successes.push(url);
      if (!proof) proof = buf;
    } catch (e) {
      // Calendar indisponible, on tente le suivant
    }
  }

  return {
    otsProof: proof ? proof.toString('base64') : null,
    calendars: successes
  };
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const projRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT p.*, u.handle as author, parent.title as parent_title
      FROM projects p
      JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id
      LEFT JOIN projects parent ON p.parent_id = parent.id
      WHERE p.id = $1
    `, [id]);
    if (projRes.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    const project = projRes.rows[0];
    const rootId = project.root_id || project.id;

    const filesRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT pf.id, pf.file_name, pf.file_hash, pf.file_size, pf.file_path, pf.uploaded_by,
             u.handle as uploaded_by_handle
      FROM project_files pf
      LEFT JOIN users u ON pf.uploaded_by = u.id
      WHERE pf.project_id = $1 ORDER BY pf.file_name ASC
    `, [id]);

    const membersRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT u.handle, u.id as user_id, pm.role, pm.added_at
      FROM project_members pm JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.id
      WHERE pm.project_id = $1 ORDER BY pm.added_at ASC
    `, [id]);

    const versionsRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, title, version_number, created_at, ots_proof
      FROM projects WHERE root_id = $1
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
    `, [rootId]);

    const latestId = versionsRes.rows[versionsRes.rows.length - 1]?.id;
    const isLatest = latestId === id;

    return NextResponse.json({
      ...project,
      files: filesRes.rows,
      members: membersRes.rows,
      versions: versionsRes.rows,
      is_latest: isLatest,
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[projects/[id] GET]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const { pubkey, handle } = await req.json();
    if (!pubkey || !handle) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const project = await pool.query("SELECT author_id FROM projects WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (project.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    if (project.rows[0].author_id !== user.rows[0].id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
    const target = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE LOWER(handle) = LOWER($1)", [handle.replace('@','')]);
    if (target.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    await pool.query("INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, user_id, role) VALUES ($1, $2, 'member') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING", [id, target.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { buildMerkleRoot } from '@/lib/merkle';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

export async function POST(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const data = await req.formData();
    const pubkey = data.get('pubkey') as string;
    const filesToKeepStr = (data.get('files_to_keep') as string) || '[]';
    if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;

    const oldRes = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (oldRes.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    const oldProject = oldRes.rows[0];

    const isOwner = oldProject.author_id === userId;
    const isMember = (await pool.query("SELECT 1 FROM project_members WHERE project_id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, userId])).rows.length > 0;
    if (!isOwner && !isMember) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 403 });

    const filesToKeep = JSON.parse(filesToKeepStr) as string[];
    const keptFilesRes = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM project_files WHERE project_id = $1 AND file_name = ANY($2)", [id, filesToKeep]);

    // Nouveaux fichiers (juste leurs hashs, pas d'upload pour l'instant)
    const newFiles = (data.getAll('new_files') as File[]).filter(f => f && f.size > 0);
    const newFileRecords: { name: string; hash: string; size: number; path: string | null }[] = [];
    for (const file of newFiles) {
      const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
      const hash = Buffer.from(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer)).toString('base64');
      newFileRecords.push({ name: file.name, hash, size: buffer.length, path: null });
    }

    const allHashes = [...keptFilesRes.rows.map(f => f.file_hash), ...newFileRecords.map(f => f.hash)];
    const merkleRoot = buildMerkleRoot(allHashes);

    const client = await pool.connect();
    let newId: string;
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      const maxVRes = await client.query("SELECT MAX(version_number) as m FROM projects WHERE root_id = $1", [oldProject.root_id || oldProject.id]);
      const newVersion = (maxVRes.rows[0].m || 0) + 1;
      
      const newProjectRes = await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO projects (author_id, title, description, merkle_root, parent_id, root_id, version_number)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) RETURNING id`,
        [oldProject.author_id, oldProject.title, oldProject.description, merkleRoot, id, oldProject.root_id || oldProject.id, newVersion]
      );
      newId = newProjectRes.rows[0].id;

      for (const f of keptFilesRes.rows) {
        await client.query(`INSERT INTO project_files (project_id, file_name, file_hash, file_size, file_path, uploaded_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
          [newId, f.file_name, f.file_hash, f.file_size, f.file_path, f.uploaded_by]);
      }
      for (const f of newFileRecords) {
        await client.query(`INSERT INTO project_files (project_id, file_name, file_hash, file_size, file_path, uploaded_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
          [newId, f.name, f.hash, f.size, f.path, userId]);
      }
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (e) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); throw e; }
    finally { client.release(); }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, project_id: newId });
  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: e?.message || 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: e?.message || 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const pubkeyInput = document.getElementById('pubkey');
  const sealBtn = document.getElementById('sealBtn');
  const status = document.getElementById('status');

  chrome.storage.local.get(['sceau_pubkey'], (result) => {
    if (result.sceau_pubkey) pubkeyInput.value = result.sceau_pubkey;
  });

  sealBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const pubkey = pubkeyInput.value.trim();
    if (!pubkey) return alert("Veuillez entrer votre clÃ© publique.");

    chrome.storage.local.set({ sceau_pubkey: pubkey });
    sealBtn.innerText = 'Envoi en cours...';

    chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, currentWindow: true }, async (tabs) => {
      const url = tabs[0].url;
      
      try {
        const res = await fetch('https://sceau-app.vercel.app/api/archive', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url })
        });
        
        if (res.ok) {
          sealBtn.style.display = 'none';
          status.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          const d = await res.json();
          alert("Erreur : " + d.error);
          sealBtn.innerText = 'Sceller cette page';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Erreur rÃ©seau. VÃ©rifiez votre connexion.");
        sealBtn.innerText = 'Sceller cette page';
      }
    });
  });
});

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

/**
 * Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 d'un fichier (Buffer ou Uint8Array).
 */
export function hashDocument(content: Uint8Array): string {
  const hash = sha256(content);
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * Ancre un hash sur la blockchain Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps.
 * Retourne la preuve .ots en base64, prÃªte Ã  Ãªtre stockÃ©e.
 */
export async function anchorToBitcoin(hashHex: string): Promise<{ otsProof: string | null, calendars: string[] }> {
  const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  const successes: string[] = [];
  let proof: Buffer | undefined;

  for (const url of CALENDARS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' },
        body: hashBytes,
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue;

      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      const magic = Buffer.from([0x00,0x4f,0x70,0x65,0x6e,0x54,0x69,0x6d,0x65,0x73,0x74,0x61,0x6d,0x70,0x73,0x00,0x00,0x50,0x72,0x6f,0x6f,0x66,0x00]);
      
      if (!buf.subarray(0, magic.length).equals(magic)) continue;

      successes.push(url);
      if (!proof) proof = buf;
    } catch (e) {
      // Calendar indisponible, on tente le suivant
    }
  }

  return {
    otsProof: proof ? proof.toString('base64') : null,
    calendars: successes
  };
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/archive/route.ts
=========================================

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30; // NÃ©cessaire pour le temps de fetch

// Fonction utilitaire pour hasher le contenu
function hashContent(content: string): string {
  const hash = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(content));
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

// GET : Lister les archives de l'utilisateur
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, url, title, status, last_checked_at, created_at 
      FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
    `, [user.rows[0].id]);
    
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      archives: result.rows, 
      is_pro: user.rows[0].is_pro,
      limit: user.rows[0].is_pro ? 50 : 3
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// POST : Ajouter une URL
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, url, action } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro;

    // 1. VÃ©rification du quota
    const countQuery = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
    const currentCount = parseInt(countQuery.rows[0].count);
    const maxLimit = isPro ? 50 : 3;

    if (currentCount >= maxLimit && action !== 'check') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} URLs max). Passez Ã  SCEAU PRO pour en ajouter plus.` }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // 2. Si c'est une vÃ©rification (action === 'check')
    if (action === 'check') {
      const archive = await pool.query("SELECT id, url, last_hash FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [url, userId]); // Ici 'url' contient l'ID
      if (archive.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      
      const targetUrl = archive.rows[0].url;
      const oldHash = archive.rows[0].last_hash;

      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
      const html = await res.text();
      const newHash = hashContent(html);

      const isModified = oldHash !== newHash;
      
      if (isModified) {
        await pool.query("UPDATE web_archives SET status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1", [url]); // 'url' = id
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'modified' });
      } else {
        await pool.query("UPDATE web_archives SET status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1", [url]);
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'intact' });
      }
    }

    // 3. Sinon, c'est une nouvelle URL
    if (!url.startsWith('http://') && !url.startsWith('https://')) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide (doit commencer par http)' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Fetch initial
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
    if (!res.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de joindre le site web.' }, { status: 400 });
    
    const html = await res.text();
    const newHash = hashContent(html);
    const title = new URL(url).hostname;

    const insert = await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, title, last_hash, status) 
      VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'intact') RETURNING id
    `, [userId, url, title, newHash]);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, id: insert.rows[0].id });

  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur lors du traitement : ' + e.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE : Supprimer une URL
export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!pubkey || !id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    await pool.query("DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, user.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import crypto from 'crypto';

// GET : Lister les clÃ©s de l'utilisateur (masquÃ©es)
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    const result = await pool.query(
      "SELECT id, name, created_at, last_used_at FROM api_keys WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC",
      [user.rows[0].id]
    );
    return NextResponse.json({ keys: result.rows });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// POST : GÃ©nÃ©rer une nouvelle clÃ©
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, name } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !name) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    // GÃ©nÃ©rer une clÃ© alÃ©atoire (sceau_live_ + 32 caractÃ¨res hexadÃ©cimaux)
    const rawKey = `sceau_live_${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex')}`;
    
    // On ne stocke que le hash SHA-256 de la clÃ© en base de donnÃ©es
    const keyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawKey).digest('hex');

    await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO api_keys (user_id, key_hash, name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)",
      [user.rows[0].id, keyHash, name]
    );

    // On retourne la clÃ© EN CLAIR une seule fois. Elle ne sera plus jamais visible.
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, key: rawKey });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE : RÃ©voquer une clÃ©
export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!pubkey || !id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    await pool.query("DELETE FROM api_keys WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, user.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { email } = await req.json();
  if (!email) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email requis' }, { status: 400 });

  const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = $1", [email]);
  if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email introuvable' }, { status: 404 });

  const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + 3600000); 

  await pool.query("UPDATE users SET reset_token = $1, reset_expiry = $2 WHERE email = $3", [token, expiry, email]);

  const resetLink = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'}/reset-password?token=${token}`;
  
  try {
    const resendKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
    if (!resendKey) {
      // Si pas de clÃ©, on simule l'envoi pour le dÃ©veloppement
      console.log("âš ï¸ Pas de clÃ© Resend. Lien de test :", resetLink);
      return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: "Lien gÃ©nÃ©rÃ© (voir console)" });
    }

    const resend = new Resend(resendKey);
    await resend.emails.send({
      from: 'SCEAU <onboarding@resend.dev>',
      to: email,
      subject: "RÃ©initialisation de votre mot de passe",
      html: `<p>Bonjour,</p><p>Voici votre lien : <a href="${resetLink}">RÃ©initialiser mon mot de passe</a></p>`,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: "Email envoyÃ© !" });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Erreur d'envoi d'email" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

const loginCache = new Map<string, { count: number, resetAt: number }>();

function checkLimit(ip: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  let e = loginCache.get(ip);
  if (!e || e.resetAt < now) { e = { count: 0, resetAt: now + 60000 }; loginCache.set(ip, e); }
  if (e.count >= 5) return false;
  e.count++;
  return true;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || 'unknown';
  if (!checkLimit(ip)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Trop de tentatives. RÃ©essayez dans 1 minute.' }, { status: 429 });

  try {
    const { email, password } = await req.json();

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1", [email]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const isValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.rows[0].password_hash);
    if (!isValid) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // On renvoie le handle et la clÃ© publique (convertie en base64)
    return NextResponse.json({
      handle: user.rows[0].handle,
      pubkey: Buffer.from(user.rows[0].pubkey).toString('base64')
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { token, newPassword } = await req.json();
  if (!token || !newPassword) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs requis' }, { status: 400 });

  const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE reset_token = $1 AND reset_expiry > NOW()", [token]);
  if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Lien invalide ou expirÃ©' }, { status: 400 });

  const salt = await bcrypt.genSalt(10);
  const password_hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, salt);

  await pool.query("UPDATE users SET password_hash = $1, reset_token = NULL, reset_expiry = NULL WHERE id = $2", [password_hash, user.rows[0].id]);

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

    const { handle, email, password, pubkey } = await req.json();

    if (!handle || !email || !password || !pubkey) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tous les champs sont requis' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const salt = await bcrypt.genSalt(10);
    const password_hash = await bcrypt.hash(password, salt);

    const result = await pool.query(

      [handle, email, password_hash, pubkey]
    );
    
    return NextResponse.json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Erreur d'inscription:", error);
    if (error.code === '23505') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Ce pseudo ou cet email est dÃ©jÃ  pris' }, { status: 409 });
    }
    // On renvoie le VRAI message d'erreur pour le dÃ©bogage
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message || 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const challenge = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM challenges WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (challenge.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });

    const entries = await pool.query(`
      SELECT e.id as entry_id, s.id as seal_id, s.title, s.description, s.file_path, s.category, 
      CASE WHEN $2 = true THEN 'Anonyme' ELSE u.handle END as author,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM challenge_votes WHERE entry_id = e.id) as votes
      FROM challenge_entries e
      JOIN seals s ON e.seal_id = s.id
      JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.id
      WHERE e.challenge_id = $1
      ORDER BY votes DESC
    `, [id, challenge.rows[0].is_anonymous]);

    return NextResponse.json({ challenge: challenge.rows[0], entries: entries.rows });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { challenge_id, entry_id, pubkey } = await req.json();
  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const voterId = user.rows[0].id;

    // VÃ©rifier qu'il ne vote pas pour lui-mÃªme
    const entry = await pool.query("SELECT user_id FROM challenge_entries WHERE id = $1", [entry_id]);
    if (entry.rows.length > 0 && entry.rows[0].user_id === voterId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tu ne peux pas voter pour ta propre Å“uvre !' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO challenge_votes (challenge_id, voter_id, entry_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING",
      [challenge_id, voterId, entry_id]
    );
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

// Lire les commentaires d'une Å“uvre
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const sealId = searchParams.get('seal_id');
  if (!sealId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ID manquant' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT c.id, c.content, c.created_at, u.handle as author
      FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id
      WHERE c.seal_id = $1 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
    `, [sealId]);
    return NextResponse.json({ comments: result.rows });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

// Ajouter un commentaire
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { seal_id, pubkey, content } = await req.json();
  if (!seal_id || !pubkey || !content) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, handle FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const myId = user.rows[0].id;

    await pool.query("INSERT INTO comments (seal_id, user_id, content) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)", [seal_id, myId, content]);

    // CrÃ©er une notification pour l'auteur de l'Å“uvre
    const seal = await pool.query("SELECT author_id, title FROM seals WHERE id = $1", [seal_id]);
    if (seal.rows.length > 0 && seal.rows[0].author_id !== myId) {
      await pool.query(
        "INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, type, message, link) VALUES ($1, $2, 'comment', $3, $4)",
        [seal.rows[0].author_id, myId, `a commentÃ© ton Å“uvre "${seal.rows[0].title}"`, `/o/${seal_id}`]
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

export async function GET() {

    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT a.id, a.type, a.content, a.media_url, a.created_at, 
             u.handle as author,
             s.id as seal_id, s.title as seal_title
      FROM attachments a 
      JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
      JOIN seals s ON a.seal_id = s.id
      WHERE a.parent_id IS NULL 
      ORDER BY RANDOM() 
      LIMIT 50
    `);
    return NextResponse.json({ creations: result.rows });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[creations/global]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { creation_id, pubkey } = await req.json();
    if (!creation_id || !pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;

    // VÃ©rifier si le like existe dÃ©jÃ 
    const existing = await pool.query("SELECT 1 FROM creation_likes WHERE attachment_id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [creation_id, userId]);
    
    if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
      // On retire le like
      await pool.query("DELETE FROM creation_likes WHERE attachment_id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [creation_id, userId]);
      return NextResponse.json({ liked: false });
    } else {
      // On ajoute le like
      await pool.query("INSERT INTO creation_likes (attachment_id, user_id) VALUES ($1, $2)", [creation_id, userId]);
      return NextResponse.json({ liked: true });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[creation_like]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/creations/route.ts

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { r2Client } from '@/lib/r2';
import { PutObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { safeKeyPart } from '@/lib/safe-key';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

// GET : RÃ©cupÃ©rer les crÃ©ations d'un sceau (ou d'une crÃ©ation si parent_id est fourni)
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const sealId = searchParams.get('seal_id');
  const parentId = searchParams.get('parent_id');

  if (!sealId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'seal_id manquant' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    let sql = `
      SELECT a.id, a.type, a.content, a.media_url, a.created_at, a.parent_id, u.handle as author, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation_likes WHERE attachment_id = a.id) as likes_count
      FROM attachments a 
      JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
      WHERE a.seal_id = $1
    `;
    const params: any[] = [sealId];

    if (parentId) {
      sql += " AND a.parent_id = $2";
      params.push(parentId);
    } else {
      sql += " AND a.parent_id IS NULL"; // On ne rÃ©cupÃ¨re que le niveau principal
    }

    sql += " ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 50";
    
    const result = await pool.query(sql, params);
    return NextResponse.json({ creations: result.rows });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[creations GET]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// POST : CrÃ©er une nouvelle crÃ©ation (vidÃ©o, image, ou texte)
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const data = await req.formData();
    const seal_id = data.get('seal_id') as string;
    const pubkey = data.get('pubkey') as string;
    const content = data.get('content') as string || '';
    const type = data.get('type') as string || 'text';
    const parent_id = data.get('parent_id') as string || null;
    const file = data.get('file') as File | null;

    if (!seal_id || !pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    let media_url: string | null = null;

    if (file && file.size > 0) {
      // === SÃ‰CURITÃ‰ : VÃ©rification de l'extension ===
      const allowedExtensions = ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp', 'mp4', 'webm', 'mp3', 'wav', 'ogg', 'pdf', 'txt'];
      const fileName = file.name.toLowerCase();
      const ext = fileName.split('.').pop() || '';
      
      if (!allowedExtensions.includes(ext)) {
        return NextResponse.json({ 
          error: `Format de fichier interdit (.${ext}).` 
        }, { status: 400 });
      }

      const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
      const { endpoint, bucket } = requireS3();
      const key = `creations/${safeKeyPart(seal_id.slice(0, 8))}/${Date.now()}-${safeKeyPart(file.name)}`;
      
      await r2Client.send(new PutObjectCommand({
        Bucket: bucket,
        Key: key,
        Body: buffer,
        ContentType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
      }));
      media_url = `${endpoint}/${bucket}/${key}`;
    }

    const res = await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO attachments (seal_id, user_id, content, type, media_url, parent_id)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) RETURNING id`,
      [seal_id, user.rows[0].id, content, type, media_url, parent_id]
    );

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, id: res.rows[0].id });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[creations POST]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur lors de la crÃ©ation' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/cron/archive-scan/route.ts
=========================================

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';
import { Resend } from 'resend';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 60;

function hashContent(content: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(content))).toString('hex');
}

function generateDiff(oldText: string, newText: string) {
  const oldLines = oldText.split('\n');
  const newLines = newText.split('\n');
  const diff = [];
  const maxLines = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);
  let changesCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
    const oldLine = oldLines[i] || '';
    const newLine = newLines[i] || '';
    if (oldLine !== newLine) {
      diff.push({ type: 'removed', text: oldLine.trim() });
      diff.push({ type: 'added', text: newLine.trim() });
      changesCount++;
    } else if (oldLine.trim() !== '') {
      diff.push({ type: 'unchanged', text: oldLine.trim() });
    }
  }
  return { changesCount, details: diff.slice(0, 100) };
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (process.env.CRON_SECRET && authHeader !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return new NextResponse('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const archives = await pool.query(`
      SELECT a.id, a.url, a.last_hash, a.last_content, u.email 
      FROM web_archives a 
      JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
    `);
    
    const resend = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY ? new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY) : null;
    let scanned = 0;
    let modifiedCount = 0;

    for (const archive of archives.rows) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(archive.url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
        if (!res.ok) continue;
        
        const html = await res.text();
        const newText = html.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n').replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n').trim();
        const newHash = hashContent(newText);

        if (archive.last_hash !== newHash) {
          const diffResult = generateDiff(archive.last_content || '', newText);
          
          await pool.query(
            "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1, last_hash = $2, last_content = $3 WHERE id = $4",
            [JSON.stringify(diffResult), newHash, newText, archive.id]
          );

          if (resend && archive.email) {
            await resend.emails.send({
              from: 'SCEAU Archive <alerte@sceau-app.vercel.app>',
              to: archive.email,
              subject: `ğŸš¨ Modification dÃ©tectÃ©e sur ${archive.url}`,
              html: `
                <div style="font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
                  <h2 style="color: #E76F51;">SCEAU Archive</h2>
                  <p>Une modification a Ã©tÃ© dÃ©tectÃ©e sur la page que vous surveillez :</p>
                  <p><a href="${archive.url}" style="background: #eee; padding: 10px; display: block; border-radius: 8px; color: #333; text-decoration: none;">${archive.url}</a></p>
                  <p><strong>${diffResult.changesCount} changements</strong> ont Ã©tÃ© trouvÃ©s.</p>
                  <a href="https://sceau-app.vercel.app/archive" style="display: inline-block; background: #1A1513; color: white; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; margin-top: 20px;">Voir le Diff complet</a>
                </div>
              `
            });
          }
          modifiedCount++;
        } else {
          await pool.query(
            "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1",
            [archive.id]
          );
        }
        scanned++;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(`Erreur scan ${archive.url}:`, e);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, scanned, modifiedCount });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cron Error' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/download/[id]/route.ts
=========================================

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { r2Client } from '@/lib/r2';
import { GetObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { Readable } from 'node:stream';
import { extractS3Key } from '@/lib/safe-key';
import { apiError } from '@/lib/api-error';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

function encodeContentDisposition(filename: string): string {
  const asciiFallback = filename
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, '_')
    .replace(/["\\]/g, '_');
  return `attachment; filename="${asciiFallback}"; filename*=UTF-8''${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`;
}

async function toWebStream(body: any): Promise<ReadableStream> {
  if (body instanceof Readable) return Readable.toWeb(body) as unknown as ReadableStream;
  if (body && typeof body.getReader === 'function') return body as ReadableStream;
  if (body && typeof body[Symbol.asyncIterator] === 'function') {
    return new ReadableStream({
      async start(controller) {
        try {
          for await (const chunk of body) controller.enqueue(chunk);
          controller.close();
        } catch (e) { controller.error(e); }
      },
    });
  }
  throw new Error('Body S3 non supportÃ©');
}

export async function GET(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const viewerPubkey = searchParams.get('viewer');

  try {
    const res = await pool.query(
      "SELECT file_path FROM seals WHERE id = $1 AND visibility = 'public'",
      [id]
    );
    if (res.rows.length === 0 || !res.rows[0].file_path) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const key = extractS3Key(res.rows[0].file_path);
    if (!key) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© S3 invalide' }, { status: 500 });

    const obj = await r2Client.send(new GetObjectCommand({
      Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET,
      Key: key,
    }));
    if (!obj.Body) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier introuvable' }, { status: 404 });

    if (viewerPubkey) {
      pool.query(
        "INSERT INTO access_log (seal_id, viewer_id, action, context) SELECT $1, id, 'download', 'public' FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $2",
        [id, viewerPubkey]
      ).catch((e) => console.warn('[download] log Ã©chouÃ©', e));
    }

    const webStream = await toWebStream(obj.Body);
    const filename = key.split('/').pop() || 'file';

    return new NextResponse(webStream, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': obj.ContentType || 'application/octet-stream',
        'Content-Disposition': encodeContentDisposition(filename),
        'Content-Length': obj.ContentLength ? String(obj.ContentLength) : '',
        'Cache-Control': 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur lors du tÃ©lÃ©chargement');
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ favorites: [] });
    
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.category, s.timestamp, u.handle as author
      FROM favorites f
      JOIN seals s ON f.seal_id = s.id
      JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
      WHERE f.user_id = $1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
    `, [user.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ favorites: result.rows });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ favorites: [] }); }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { seal_id, pubkey, action } = await req.json(); // action: 'add' | 'remove'
  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    if (action === 'remove') {
      await pool.query("DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id = $1 AND seal_id = $2", [user.rows[0].id, seal_id]);
    } else {
      await pool.query("INSERT INTO favorites (user_id, seal_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING", [user.rows[0].id, seal_id]);
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const myHandle = searchParams.get('me');

  if (!myHandle) return NextResponse.json({ friends_seals: [] });

  try {
    // 1. On trouve l'ID de l'utilisateur
    const me = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE handle = $1", [myHandle]);
    if (me.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ friends_seals: [] });
    const myId = me.rows[0].id;

    // 2. On trouve les gens avec qui j'ai discutÃ© (mes contacts)
    const contactsQuery = await pool.query(`
      SELECT DISTINCT receiver_id as contact_id FROM messages WHERE sender_id = $1
      UNION
      SELECT DISTINCT sender_id as contact_id FROM messages WHERE receiver_id = $1
    `, [myId]);

    if (contactsQuery.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ friends_seals: [] });
    const contactIds = contactsQuery.rows.map(r => r.contact_id);

    // 3. On rÃ©cupÃ¨re leurs derniÃ¨res Å“uvres publiques (5 max)
    const seals = await pool.query(`
      SELECT s.id, s.title, s.timestamp, u.handle as author
      FROM seals s JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
      WHERE s.author_id = ANY($1) AND s.is_public = TRUE
      ORDER BY s.timestamp DESC LIMIT 5
    `, [contactIds]);

    return NextResponse.json({ friends_seals: seals.rows });
  } catch (error) { 
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); 
  }
}
